title: Dramatic Trees - Natura Legacy
description: Compatibility mod between Dramatic Trees and Natura Legacy
body:
### What is this?
Dramatic Trees - Natura Legacy is a fork of [Dynamic Trees - Natura](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/dynamic-trees-natura)

This is part of a series of addons for [Dramatic Trees](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/dramatictrees), a fork of Dynamic Trees, aimed at continuing development of the afforementioned mods/fixing previously unresolved issues.

As such, Dramatic Trees - Natura Legacy depends on [Dramatic Trees](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/dramatictrees).

---

### Dramatic Trees - Natura includes a few changes/fixes from the original mod. Most notably:
- Fixes to [Bloodwood Textures](https://github.com/TerraFirmaCraft-The-Final-Frontier/DramaticTrees-NaturaLegacy/commit/25c1b918418801a60f290be8eb660746717b3868)
- [Stick variant configuration](https://github.com/TerraFirmaCraft-The-Final-Frontier/DramaticTrees-NaturaLegacy/commit/2adf1fbeb1aa7fe63a7109f65e6c33620d1a2ad1)
- [Addition of Apple Trees](https://github.com/TerraFirmaCraft-The-Final-Frontier/DramaticTrees-NaturaLegacy/commit/0141fd368716bd54d55ba42377c08a0224ff2f2b)
- More to come!

### Potential future plans?
- To be determined…
